subject: Social Media
title: Metcalfe's Law
description: A fast breakdown of Metcalfe's Law for builders.

hook.text: A phone network with one user is useless. With two, it has one connection. With ten, it has 45.

buildup.text: Metcalfe's Law: a network's value grows with the square of its users. Doubling users quadruples value.

discovery.text: This explains why social platforms grow explosively. Each new user makes the network better for all.

twist.text: It also explains lock-in. Leaving Facebook means losing your connections. The network owns you.

climax.text: Critics say Metcalfe overestimates. Not all connections are equal. Your thousandth friend adds little.

punchline.text: The network's value isn't in the product. It's in you.

quiz.question: According to Metcalfe's Law, how does network value grow?
